title: Quality indexes Q1: the collector, the quality module of the Signal Center and evolve quality report
summary: ADR-0153 makes quality a panel of separate indexes with intervals, published only through the Signal Center. Nothing computes or emits them today. Q1 builds the shared core that every other quality component uses: the statistics, the reading signal, the codes, the command, the boundary step and the channel routes. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-quality-indexes.md §4 and §5. Plan: docs/plans/llm-quality-indexes-2026-10.md §6 Q1. The package is new: internal/qualityindex already holds the review-score grammar, so the collector lives in internal/qualitypanel.
fix: Add internal/qualitypanel with Wilson 95% (spec §4.2), cluster bootstrap by wave with a fixed seed (§4.3), the MDE (§4.6) and the breach test on the whole interval (§4.4). Add module quality, kinds quality.reading (INFO), quality.breach and quality.warning (WARN), and register QUALITY_<ID>_BREACH for the 19 ids that have a threshold (spec §1 table, all ids but PQ3 and JQ4) plus QUALITY_SOURCE_ABSENT, QUALITY_VACUOUS_DENOMINATOR and QUALITY_SOURCE_UNREADABLE; regenerate docs/architecture/signal-codes.md. Add the three kinds to legacyProjectKinds (go/cmd/evolve/cmd_cycle.go). Build the Center with newRoleSignalCenter("quality", ...). Add evolve quality report --scope wave|tree|judges|replay, a boundary step before gc, the channels quality.breach (lossless) and quality.reading (best_effort) in policy.EventsDefaults, and policy quality.indexes.<id>.stage with compiled default shadow.
acceptance: RED first: a reading with k=3, n=5 emits quality.reading with value 0.600, lo 0.231 and hi 0.882 (Wilson 95%)
A reading whose interval crosses its threshold emits status=inconclusive and no quality.breach
At stage shadow no quality.breach is emitted; at stage report a breach emits QUALITY_<ID>_BREACH at WARN
A reading with n=0 emits QUALITY_VACUOUS_DENOMINATOR; an absent source emits QUALITY_SOURCE_ABSENT
Every index that the collector computes emits through signalcenter and is visible in evolve signals tail --kind quality.reading,quality.breach,quality.warning
evolve signals codes check passes with the new codes in docs/architecture/signal-codes.md
The boundary runs evolve quality report --scope wave after sync-main and before gc, and a collector failure does not fail the boundary (WARN only)
No code path reads a quality signal to change a stage or a verdict (test: the stage comes only from policy)
New package at 100% coverage, in go/.cover-strict and go/.apicover-enforce
Each reading carries at most 11 field keys, and a test shows that every key survives signalcenter.Normalize (MaxFields is 12); unit, direction and baseline live in the index registry
Indexes with a baseline (CQ1, CQ2, PQ1, PQ3, PQ4, JQ3, JQ4, OQ2, OQ3) default to stage report; the rest default to shadow
19 breach codes are registered, one per id with a threshold; stage gate emits the same signals as report (table test over the three stages)
Cycle-0 quality readings are readable through evolve signals tail --channel (quality.reading, quality.breach, signals)
